ValidationRule.description: PRM - Prevents partners from changing lead status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( $Profile.Name = 'PCL-Partner User', $Profile.Name = 'PCL-Partner Manager', $Profile.Name = 'PCN-Partner Manager', $Profile.Name = 'PCN-Partner User' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead Status cannot be changed. Please contact your Channel Manager for assistance.
